verdict.rationale: Session lifecycle management is a fair axis for an identity platform like Auth0, but the evidence pack never documents session expiry settings, refresh-token rotation for user sessions, or server-side revocation of a compromised session. The nearby items do not count toward this story. SSO describes one-time authentication across apps rather than session controls. Token Vault refreshes third-party API tokens for agents, which is a different capability. Blocking breached users from logging in is an adjacent control, not session revocation.
